recommendation.summary: dsh-agy-link@0.4.40 is a DSH plugin that bridges Google Antigravity models through the official unmodified `agy` CLI. Node 24 is the only evidenced major: engines.node is ">=24.0.0" in both source and published manifests (declared support), and both the CI and publish workflows configure node-version 24 (CI-tested). No explicit author recommendation naming a major was found, so Node 24 is recorded as ci-tested rather than author-recommended; the DSH repository baseline (^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0) is a platform fact, not a plugin preference. The manifest declares dsh.client.platform=web, and plugin-owned docs install into and launch the web profile, so web is the primary workflow. The README also carries a plugin-owned "Headless operation" section describing headless/print behavior and permission handling, recorded as an additional workflow. No TUI, SDK, or ACP workflow is documented. No exact package manager version is pinned, and no explicit author DSH validation baseline was found beyond development devDependency pins of DSH packages at 0.1.2-rc.1. The plugin depends on an externally installed agy CLI, interactive Google OAuth, and Google network reachability, none of which generic smoke checks can exercise.
